source: Fleeting weekly discovery crawl whole-board history (board_source.py)
methodology: A window is a comeback only when the board history shows all four: it is on this week's board, it was absent from the immediately-preceding bundle, an earlier bundle carried a genuinely-passed close date (so it really closed - board absence alone is never read as a closure), and its current listing is forward-looking. We claim only that its last run ended on closed_on and it is back now. No guessed comebacks; a missing current end date is 'ongoing', not invented.

items.title: Fixin's Fest featuring The Cornbread Cook Off
items.blurb: Side dishes from favorite local eateries gather under one roof for the first Fixin's Fest and Cornbread Cook Off. Grab a plate, rank your favorites, then line dance. Noon to 4pm, no refunds.

items.title: The Last Waltz Tribute
items.blurb: A tribute staging of the legendary farewell concert, one night only.

items.title: Songwriters Night for Ronald McDonald House Nashville
items.blurb: The Ronald McDonald House Nashville Associate Board presents a songwriters night, part of the Backstage Nashville series.

items.title: House of Feels
items.blurb: A one-night bill featuring Maeday, Vanguard, Umoya, Nashville Black Market and Nashfeels.

items.title: Eva Cassel Album Release Show
items.blurb: An album release night with Liam Bauman and Leah Marlene opening, so you hear the new songs on day one.

items.title: Nashville Official Thanksgiving Eve Bar Crawl 2026
items.blurb: One wristband covers 4+ downtown bars with Thanksgiving-themed drink specials, live DJs at select venues and a free after party. It runs 8 p.m. to 2 a.m. on the eve, 21+ with ID, and has sold out before.

items.title: Jimmy Eat World: 25 Years of Bleed American
items.blurb: An anniversary tour stop with Texas Is the Reason and illuminati hotties on the bill. Vinyl Room and Fast Lane add-ons are sold separately.

items.title: Audi 2026 MLS Playoffs Round 1, Game 1
items.blurb: Playoff soccer on a Sunday afternoon, against FCC or ORL depending on how the bracket settles.

items.title: The Basement East 2-Night Pass 2027
items.blurb: A two-night pass covering a weekend at The Basement East, so one purchase gets you both nights.

items.title: Santa Photos at Opry Mills
items.blurb: Santa is back at the mall for photos, running through Christmas Eve. Pricing and hours are not stated in the listing.

items.title: Author event with Bonnie Garmus
items.blurb: An evening with the author of Lessons in Chemistry, in a proper auditorium. Tickets start at 37 USD.

items.title: A Soulful M**der Mystery
items.blurb: A one-night murder mystery show at Plaza Mariachi. Tickets are listed at $75.

items.title: Nashville Fiddle Banjo Camp 2026
items.blurb: Four days of fiddle and banjo immersion for anyone who wants to play better or just be around people who do. The listing gives no price or schedule detail.

items.title: ROOTED: A Tea Ritual & Sound Bath
items.blurb: A tea ritual paired with a sound bath, which is a gentle way to spend a Saturday morning downtown. Price is not stated.

items.title: From Grape to Grandeur: A Nebbiolo Story
items.blurb: Wine Director Nicole Lee leads a guided tasting that follows Nebbiolo across Piemonte, from lighter aromatic styles up to Barbaresco and Barolo. It is part of Yolan's monthly wine and spirits series. Saturday at 4 PM.

items.title: Artist Talk & Walk
items.blurb: An artist talk and walk through The Arcade over a three-hour Saturday evening window. No price or artist is named in the listing.
